name: RUNX family transcription factor 1

function.text: RUNX1 encodes a DNA-binding transcription factor that forms the core-binding factor complex with CBFB and regulates hematopoietic development and differentiation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to hereditary thrombocytopenia and hematologic cancer predisposition syndrome (autosomal dominant); hereditary thrombocytopenia and hematological cancer predisposition syndrome associated with RUNX1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Myeloid sarcoma; Systemic mastocytosis; Acute myeloid leukemia. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
